Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 24% of the way down her figure from the top, about 54% of the way down her figure from the top and about 71% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but fractal energy burst formations in ELECTRIC GREEN and GOLD glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
